inventory.verifyTreeRule: A verify hook (pre-verify / post-verify) gates the STORY worktree <worktreeRoot>/<story>, checked out at the PR head — the tree the verifier judges. It never runs in the main checkout and never in the review worktree <worktreeRoot>/<story>-review: that detached tree is created and removed by the verify agent itself (review-phase SKILL.md:57), so it does not exist when pre-verify runs and is gone by post-verify. The packet-level $worktree override for verify is therefore NOT the hook cwd. Every other stage: packet $worktree == story worktree, so the rule is one rule: stage hooks run in the story worktree.
inventory.equivalence: pre-<stage>/post-<stage> for prepare/validate/implement/green share one rule (packet $worktree == story worktree), exercised through implement (g1-w1..w4); verify is a distinct class (packet $worktree is the review tree) with its own rows g1-w8..w11.
